{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Count unique patients
n_patients = len(deduplicated_data)

# Print the result
print(n_patients)"}
